title: The best to do list
body:
I love a minimal app that I can customize it to my liking. How I use it:
I start by today’s tasks
with empty tasks that indicate a free time between the tasks

e.g.
[Laundry]
[shower]
[———]
[meet with ahmed @8pm]

Then I divide the rest of the tasks like this
[——-TOMORROW——-]
Tomorrow’s tasks here
[———This Week———]
I put this weeks tasks here
[——-Weekend———]
[——Next week (Aug w4) —]
a good tip here is to mention the week number either based on which week is it in the month or year, to keep track of the dates.

Finally:
[————Later———-]
here you can put anything you might do, without knowing when.

Tips:
- always use this method with a calendar, e. g. Google Calendar. 
- don’t make the the reminder page full, try to merge tasks together or drag one into the other to make a list of a tasks. 
- Don’t show completed tasks, the whole point is to have the least resistance to start the work
